purpose: A native anchor for navigation, with optional icons and explicit external-link behavior.
behaviorProvider: Native anchor and forwarded anchor ref.

component: Render a native anchor with href and forwarded ref. external defaults target to _blank unless target is supplied, and supplies an external icon unless trailingIcon is present.
For any effective _blank target merge noopener and noreferrer into rel and append visually hidden new-tab text when enabled.
host: Supply a safe intended URL and meaningful link text. Own router integration, destination permission and server authorization.
Use Button for actions; do not override disabled semantics or provide interactive descendants.

requirements.statement: Render a native anchor with href and forwarded ref. external defaults target to _blank unless target is supplied, and supplies an external icon unless trailingIcon is present.
For any effective _blank target merge noopener and noreferrer into rel and append visually hidden new-tab text when enabled.
Disabled removes href and target, sets aria-disabled, removes the anchor from Tab order, and prevents/stops click before the caller handler.
Hide leading and trailing icon wrappers from assistive technology while keeping children as the visible link label.
Supply a safe intended URL and meaningful link text. Own router integration, destination permission and server authorization.
Use Button for actions; do not override disabled semantics or provide interactive descendants.

Use trigger group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: disabled is a UI state, not access control. Arbitrary supplied URLs are not validated or sanitized by Link.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
